text:
Anika (CEO): Quick recap from today's all-hands Q&A — thanks for the energy. I'm dropping clarifications, links, and a compact action list so owners know next steps. Recording + deck: https://redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23-summary (internal). :sparkles:

Devon (CTO): Two infra clarifications from the roadmap question: 1) Canary capacity for model rollouts will be 10% traffic by default. 2) Auto-fallback will route to the nearest compatible model variant (configurable).

Priya (VP Product): Noted. We'll add those defaults to the rollout docs and include a short example YAML for route policies.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Customers asked if we can preview cost impact before switching a route to a quantized model. Can we add a Console "estimate" button?

Devon (CTO): Good idea. Product + Infra: short UX flow + telemetry hook. It should run locally against recent token stats or via opt-in telemetry. Legal check needed for telemetry.

Kara (Support): Pilot customers asked about escalation paths during onboarding week. We'll provide a dedicated Slack channel + 2-hour priority response window during that week.

Anika (CEO): Nice. I'll summarize action items here. Please drop JIRA links when tasks are created. If anyone expects delays, flag by 2026-03-28 so we can re-plan.

Action items:
- Priya (VP Product) -> add rollout defaults + example route policy YAML to playbook; create issue and link it here by 2026-04-02 (#JIRA-3401)
- Devon (CTO) -> spec for Console "cost estimate" button and fallback routing doc; draft due 2026-04-06 (#JIRA-3402)
- Ravi (Solutions Eng) -> prototype customer-facing estimator text + example scenarios for demos; due 2026-04-05 (#JIRA-3403)
- Kara (Support) -> build pilot onboarding support checklist and Slack channel template; due 2026-03-31 (#JIRA-3404)
- Anika (CEO) -> host a 15-min check-in at next leadership sync on 2026-03-30 to validate progress

infra-bot: Calendar event created: "AH follow-ups: rollout defaults & estimator" 2026-03-30 09:15 PST — https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1938127777

Priya (VP Product): I'll start the YAML example now and post in #eng-runtime for feedback.

Devon (CTO): I'll coordinate with Legal on telemetry wording once Product posts the spec. Ping me if you need a review.

Anika (CEO): Great. Thanks team  let's keep momentum and close these before pilot invites go out. :rocket:
